column1: # Black/Matrix AD - Chapter 3 Pandemonium / mercenary encounter
# No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies pixel-aware line breaks.

column2: Hey, old man...
I've been wondering: those prideful black $$羽$$, even when dealing with customers...
do you not think it strange that they would bow down and do business with white $$羽$$ like us...?!
It is proof above all else that they recognize us as strong...
We generally take a keen interest in any business that may strengthen our own power...
but only when our customer is clearly stronger than us, or when we do not know who they are...
do we humble ourselves and cautiously feel them out...
After all, defying a stronger person carelessly means death...
Even so, if the customer is someone they dislike...
they make a point of staying quiet and avoid transparent pleasantries or flattery...
Naturally, their customers are accustomed to that sort of treatment...
and may actually trust a proprietor more for saying what he thinks,
becoming regulars is hardly unusual...
$$レブ$$, you killed this city's previous $$領主$$, didn't you?
Then the city changed under its new $$領主$$.
Yeah. In the end, I...
was the one who set those changes in motion...
The city has become like this...
I wonder how my little brother $$パルタ$$ is doing... I'm so worried about him...
A $$領主$$ with the power to change an entire city, yet who still craves power!
What a marvelous incarnation of $$強欲$$!
Right, $$お師匠さま$$?!
Indeed!
If he is that sort of man, it would be no surprise if he has the armor in question.
The $$大邪神$$'s... armor??
I don't recognize you lot! What are you doing in this city?
I'm looking for work!
We're here to take you down!
Hey, hey, hey, hey!!
You people don't seem to understand your position.
You're saying you came here to become the guards hired to take you down?
How embarrassiiiiing!
Could you people be complete idiots?
Hey, hey, hey, hey!!
Do you people seriously think you're stronger than us or something?!
Pff, pff, pff, pff!
Could you people really be complete idiots?!
What did you say?!
We figured out long ago that you're the fugitives the $$マモン$$ spoke of from that $$教団$$...
we've known all along!!
Hey, hey, look closely! Even the disgrace of our village,
that coward $$ピリポ$$, is mixed in with you?!
What is this? Have you sunk so low that you've become the $$奴隷$$ of some white $$羽$$?!
Well, all the better for us.
This city's fine $$領主$$, $$マモン$$, is paying us a pile of money! So you lot...
are going to die here!!
Getting paid just to cause trouble—now that's good work!
Are you people seriously saying that?!
You're selling your $$自由$$ piece by piece for money!!
Everyone has changed.
Is money really more important than life...?
